crossRefs.note: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabit the earth.

Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of Moab,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith Jehovah.
